label: Macrophage-specific targeting of histone demethylases with small-molecule inhibitors suppresses inflammatory response in vivo.
summary: Macrophages are versatile immune cells, with the ability to respond to varied intrinsic and extrinsic cues, and transition between inflammatory and pro-reparative phenotypes. A complex network of epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation, and histone methylation and acetylation, plays key roles in modulating macrophage polarization and inflammatory gene expression.
